note: English surfaces that are also real Italian words. A learner typing ordinary English hits these and, without the guard, banks the strongest possible evidence on the Italian word they never used. See runtime/classifier/english-collisions.ts.
provenance: Authored from knowledge of both languages, then filtered to surfaces that actually resolve in it/morphology.json. NOT measured from captured violations the way the Spanish list was -- there is no Italian capture corpus, and waiting for one meant shipping the bug. Membership is pinned by test, so growth is a reviewed diff either way.
inclusionRule: The ENGLISH word must be common. Italian band is not the criterion: a false credit only happens if a learner writing English would plausibly type the word. Where the English word is rare (capo, penne, stanza, volta, novella) listing it would cost Italian learners credit and prevent almost nothing, so those are deliberately left out.
